Subject: Redwood — Private deploy readiness packet (initial deliverables)

Steve / Orion team — attaching our initial deliverables and inline answers to the checklist you sent. High level: Redwood supports three KMS integration patterns for private/on‑prem installs:

1) Customer‑managed cloud KMS (recommended where network egress policies allow): Redwood integrates with AWS KMS / GCP KMS using customer keys and IAM roles; keys never leave KMS and ciphertext is stored in your infrastructure.
2) On‑prem HSM adapter: We support PKCS#11 compatible HSMs via a connector; secrets are provisioned to the HSM and Redwood can operate with keys resident in the appliance.
3) Local key escrow with hardware module (air‑gapped): For fully isolated installs we provide an operator‑facing key escrow workflow and optional hardware token lifecycle guidance.

Operator access for air‑gapped installs:
- Operators authenticate to the appliance via a local operator account tied to your directory (LDAP/AD integration supported) or via temporary elevated token issued by your security team.
- Maintenance windows use an "operator rotation" model: a named operator account and time‑boxed session tokens are recorded in audit logs.
- Remote support model: we do not require persistent outbound connectivity; support bundles (logs/diagnostics) are exchanged via signed USB or customer‑controlled import/export mechanisms.

Attachments included: redwood_private_deploy_readiness.docx, operator-training-outline.pdf, kms-integration-diagram.png

Excerpt from checklist answers (full doc attached):
- Network egress: outbound-only CIDR ranges are configurable. Default product telemetry can be disabled for air‑gapped installs.
- Patch delivery: signed patch bundles delivered via customer artifact repository or physical media; documented rollback steps included.
- Telemetry & logging: local audit stores with optional streaming to customer SIEM when connectivity permitted.

Next steps we propose:
1) We’ll complete the filled checklist and return a signed evidence pack by COB Friday if that timeline works.
2) Schedule a 45‑minute technical walkthrough (Irene to lead) to review KMS/HSM integration and show the operator training outline.
3) Provide a sample operator training slide deck and a 2‑week training plan for your ops staff.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you want to go line‑by‑line.

—Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_readiness.docx; operator-training-outline.pdf; kms-integration-diagram.png

Hi Steve / Lisa — thanks, appreciate the specific asks. Answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Supported HSM vendors (PKCS#11 adapter): Thales/Entrust Luna, Utimaco, SoftHSM (for lab/test). We validate HSM adapter compatibility during onboarding and recommend HSM firmware verification as part of your device lifecycle policies. For air‑gapped installs we can include a signed firmware checklist template for your procurement team.

2) Audit retention: Redwood stores local operator audit entries indefinitely by default on customer managed storage. Recommended baseline for high‑assurance customers is 3 years; we can easily set a 1‑year immutable retention if that’s your requirement and provide guidance on immutable storage (WORM) options. All operator actions are cryptographically signed and timestamped; export format is standard syslog and JSONL for ingestion into SIEM.

3) Operator onboarding checklist (redacted example):
- Verify operator identity in AD/LDAP; map to role mapping (operator/readonly/maintenance)
- Complete 8 hours of hands‑on lab training (includes failover, patch apply, rollback)
- Sign operator NDA and follow escalation protocol
- Confirm 2‑factor device bound to operator account (Yubikey/HSM token)

Attachments included here: operator-training-outline.pdf (detailed syllabus), redwood_private_deploy_readiness.docx (completed checklist), kms-integration-diagram.png

Next steps:
- I’ll upload the full evidence pack to the shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign for our standard private‑deploy SLA for review: https://drive.google.com/redwood/orion-health/private-deploy-readiness
